'''Mark Cimino''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[December 2001 Pennsylvania tournament]] on 15 December 2001 with Set Your Course with TIE Interceptors and Dreadnaughts, according to Rypcord Kline's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3177">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-16-twilight-games-12-15-01-chase-the-cansd3177/ twilight-games-12-15-01-chase-the-cans], DeckTech (Rypcord "Rypcord" Kline, 16 December 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-12-16-twilight-games-12-15-01-chase-the-cansd3177/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
